title: The Great Storm
bible: "But the Lord sent out a great wind into the sea, and there was a mighty tempest..." - Jonah 1:4

title: The Deep
bible: "Now the Lord had prepared a great fish to swallow up Jonah. And Jonah was in the belly of the fish three days and three nights." - Jonah 1:17

title: The City of Nineveh
bible: "So Jonah arose, and went unto Nineveh... and he cried, and said, Yet forty days, and Nineveh shall be overthrown." - Jonah 3:3-4

title: The Tree and the Heat
bible: "And the Lord God prepared a gourd... that it might be a shadow over his head... But God prepared a worm when the morning rose... and it smote the gourd that it withered." - Jonah 4:6-7

title: The Ship to Tarshish
bible: Explore the ship and discover what Jonah missed as he tried to flee.
gameInstructions: Jonah ran to Joppa and boarded a ship. Explore the deck, check the cargo, and cast lots to see what fate awaits.

title: The Belly of the Fish
bible: Inside the great fish, Jonah had time to think. Explore this dark, strange place.
gameInstructions: Three days and three nights in the belly of the fish. Sink deeper, collect fragments of hope, and pray in the alcove.

title: The Streets of Nineveh
bible: The great city of Nineveh. Walk its streets and witness the repentance.
gameInstructions: Jonah walked through Nineveh crying out. Visit the gates, cry out in the square, and watch the city from the palace.

title: East of the City
bible: Jonah sat under the plant, angry that Nineveh was spared. Explore this final scene.
gameInstructions: Under the shade of the plant, Jonah wrestled with God's mercy. Examine the plant, encounter the worm, and answer the final question.
